schoolTaskDesc11641.ch: 伏羲仰观天文俯察地理，画八卦于卦台山，现宗门将八卦精义传授于你，希望你在研习之后能为其他弟子开坛讲解。

schoolTaskDesc11806.ch: 万物自有其生长的周期，果实若是不摘也会自行腐败。前往宗门后山园林之地采摘灵果。
schoolTaskDesc11806.en: All things have their season. If fruit is not picked, it will wither on the vine. Go to the orchards in the mountains behind the Sect and pick the Spiritual Fruit.

schoolTaskDesc11811.ch: 修仙虽要辟谷，但口腹之欲实乃人之常情。前往宗门后山的野外灶台上烹饪出一道浓汤。
schoolTaskDesc11811.en: While Cultivators aspire to be free from hunger, it doesn't mean they don't feel hungry sometimes. Go to the oven in the mountains behind the Sect and make some soup.
